stated_limitation: This analysis uses representative data generated to match the Tingley et al. dataset structure.

justification.dataset: It named a real, relevant hippocampal ripple dandiset (000218, Tingley et al.) but never actually loaded or engaged with it, so the phenomenon is not demonstrated in any real data.
justification.handling: No real data was used; the entire analysis runs on np.random.seed(42) synthetic Poisson spikes, random-walk position, and fabricated LFP, an automatic zero.
justification.analysis: The decoding pipeline operates on simulated data with no true spatial tuning, so it does not test hippocampal replay at all.
justification.correctness: Every reported number derives from fabricated data and the 775.8 ripples/min rate is physically impossible for real SWRs, yet it is presented as a real finding.
justification.figures: The tuning curve is an inverted quadratic bowl (opposite of a place field) and the decoded-trajectory figure has three of four panels blank, displaying artifacts of noise rather than a real effect.
justification.honesty: The executive summary and summary.txt repeatedly assert real DANDI findings while the data were entirely synthesized, a fabrication that caps and zeroes this axis despite a buried README admission.
